newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran to host regional meeting on Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Iran to host regional meeting on Afghanistan.

text.p: Iran will host a regional conference on Afghanistan next week to seek a solution to the Afghan crisis, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Friday.

It quoted Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Mahmoud Mohammadi as saying Russia, India, Pakistan, China, Saudi Arabia and the Central Asian states, would attend the two-day meeting scheduled to open in Tehran on Tuesday .

"Foreign ministers of countries which are friendly with Afghanistan and interested in its destiny will gather...to find a regional solution out of the current crisis," Mohammadi said. He did not specify which states would send their foreign ministers.

The aim of the meeting was "to help materialise humanitarian and Islamic goals in the wake of the United Nations' inability on financial grounds to send peace-keeping forces to Afghanistan to end hostilities in that country", he said
The European Union and the Organisation of the Islamic Conference had also been invited to the meeting, he added.
Iran on Wednesday blasted the radical Islamic Afghan Taleban militia as "rebels", and reiterated its recognition of the government of President Burhanuddin Rabbani.
Tehran has called on Afghan warring factions to stop fighting and seek a power-sharing agreement.
Iran's media have accused Pakistan of setting up the Taleban with backing from the United States and funding from Saudi Arabia to counter Iran's influence in the region.
